description.value:
A specialized hardpoint or recess lets a weapon be built directly into your drone companion's frame. It gains one weapon mount. You can install or uninstall a weapon into the mount as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait. A one-handed weapon requires one weapon mount; a two-handed weapon requires two. When installed, the companion is wielding the weapon and can't be Disarmed of it. It can Interact to reload the weapon; this Interact loses the manipulate trait and requires no free hands.

Special You can select this customization repeatedly, gaining an additional weapon mount each time.
